question: Can banking part of the position at 3R while retaining an 8R runner monetize the observed winner tail better than either whole-position endpoint?

owner_authorization.scope: autonomous 5min/15min research; this stage changes runner fraction only
owner_authorization.holdout_policy: one final use only after a candidate clears all pre-holdout gates

window.audit_open_rule: open only for a timeframe whose selected runner fraction passes the development success gate
window.audit_contamination: baseline aggregate outcomes were previously seen; runner fractions are frozen before audit

signal_frozen.core: K1 directional real body truly crosses SMA(HL2); K2 wick touches it while the full body and close remain on the directional side
signal_frozen.secondary_score: same twelve-component equal-weight causal score as predecessor

factor.name: runner_fraction_after_3r
factor.mechanism: At the first intrabar hit of 3R, exit one minus runner_fraction at the 3R barrier and keep runner_fraction for 8R, protection, original stop, or timeout.
factor.cost_policy: Apply one 20bp position-weighted round-trip cost to the aggregate gross return; proportional partial exits do not duplicate full-position cost.
factor.same_bar_policy: Stop first when stop and either target coexist; if 8R is reached without a stop, 3R and 8R fills both occur at their barriers.

selection.method: single registered runner-fraction grid per timeframe on development only
selection.score: median half-year net bp minus 0.5 times population standard deviation
selection.move_rule: candidate must meet sample eligibility, improve robust score by at least 2bp versus zero runner, and not reduce worst-fold net bp by more than 3bp
selection.tie_break: higher robust score, higher worst fold, more events, then smaller runner fraction
selection.no_pass: retain full exit at 3R and record best observed arm separately
selection.development_success_requires: selected mean net bp > 0, robust score > 0, worst fold net bp > -5, and every development fold has positive gross bp
selection.futility: if neither timeframe passes, do not open audit or final holdout; conclude exit mechanics cannot repair the current entry pool
selection.claim_limit: one-dimensional runner screen with frozen 3R/8R anchors, not a global optimum

matched_control.role: descriptive negative control for every development arm; excluded from selection and all success gates

autonomous_next_stage.on_development_failure: stop exit-family optimization and run a causal failure-segmentation study before any further signal proposal
autonomous_next_stage.on_audit_failure: stop exit-family optimization and run a causal failure-segmentation study
autonomous_next_stage.on_audit_success: freeze the runner and perform the one authorized final holdout assessment
